senses.definition: Present only in scattered, separate places rather than across the whole.
senses.caution: It is honest, but a sponsor who hears adoption is in pockets hears that it has not been adopted. Use it when asking to connect the groups, not when asking for more money.
senses.example: Adoption is real, but it's in pockets — three teams live in it and nobody else has logged in since March.

cues.text: A sponsor asks whether the new tool has landed across the business. It has landed in four teams and nowhere else, and you want to be honest without sounding defeated.
You are writing a status note about the new engineering practice: a few separate teams use it fully and the rest of the firm does not use it at all.
An MD asks whether data quality is a firm-wide problem. It is bad in a few specific places and fine everywhere else.
A friend asks whether a neighbourhood is safe. It mostly is, apart from a few isolated streets.
You are describing how mobile signal behaves on a route you drive: fine in scattered places, gone in between.

distractors: Covering a wide range of cases rather than a narrow one, said of scope or coverage.
Tangled into something so completely that you can no longer act independently of it.
A range with no natural joints in it, where the cases shade into one another.
On the whole, allowing for exceptions nobody is going to list.
To make a bad situation worse than it already was.
